<div class="card-body">
'''Dianoga''' is a [[Dark]] [[Creature]] ([[Swamp]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダイアノーガ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊凶暴性＝（最後に食べたキャラクターか生物の戦闘力／凶暴性）＋運命数。生息地：ダゴバの屋外、「ゴミ圧縮装置」、および「よどみきった汚水」。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Dianoga-PSA-156625014.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヴォドランのジャングルに原生する“ゴミ溜め大イカ”。食べたものによって体の色が変化する。空腹時には透明。ほとんどんなものでも食い尽くす。自在に動く眼柄と、最大6mに達する7本の触手を持つ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dianoga.

'''Card text:'''
* Ferocity = (power/ferocity of the last character or creature eaten) + destiny. Habitat: exterior Dagobah, Trash Compactor, and Dark Waters.

'''Lore:'''
A “garbage-dump giant squid” native to Vodran's jungles. Its body color changes with what it ate. When hungry it turns transparent. It eats almost anything. It has a flexible eyestalk and seven tentacles up to 6 m long.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 「ゴミ圧縮装置」 and 「よどみきった汚水」. Printed subtype is 沼沢地生物.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dianoga]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
